title: Patient Payment Plan Enrollable Account Conditions by Tier
content:
The same account conditions apply on every **Patient Payment Plan** tier. They state which encounter account statuses may have their balances enrolled, and which balances stay out.

| Tier | Account status whose balance may be enrolled | Balances still awaiting insurance adjudication never enrolled | Account on a charge-dispute or good-faith-estimate-dispute hold not enrolled until the dispute is resolved | Balance placed with the collection agency may be enrolled without first being recalled |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | patient due | Yes | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | patient due | Yes | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | patient due | Yes | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | patient due | Yes | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | patient due | Yes | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | patient due | Yes | Yes | No |

A hypothetical account in patient due status with no hold and no agency placement meets every condition in the table; the same account while its balance still awaits insurance adjudication is never enrolled.
